summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a binding term sheet with Ascendis Pharma A/S for a global settlement and license agreement. BioMarin will grant Ascendis a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-bearing license to certain patents covering TransCon CNP, navepegritide, and Yuviwel. Ascendis will pay royalties of 20% on US net sales and 18% on EU, Brazil, and South Korea net sales until May 2030. All pending litigation will be dismissed with prejudice. The term sheet includes non-challenge and non-interference covenants. The final agreement is expected by September 24, 2026. This is a litigation settlement and licensing arrangement, not a classic special situation.
